title: 第24章 研武大会前夕第25章 研武大会
slug: 以下犯上徒弟着实貌美
lines: 众人看着风翼从镯子里倒出小山般的灵币，全都傻眼了。
这小家伙居然比他们都有钱！
“等等！”
欧阳叙白一把按住风翼的小爪子，“你哪来这么多钱？该不会是偷拿主人的吧？”
“什么呀，我才不是你呢，”
风翼骄傲地挺起小胸脯：“这都是我自己赚的辛苦钱！”
说着还掏出一本小账本：“看，每一笔都有记录！”
赵归涯接过账本翻了翻，面具下的眼睛越瞪越大：“好家伙，你连我哥的钱都敢赚？这一笔‘帮主人的哥哥找丢失的玉佩，收费五百灵币’是怎么回事？你比我还奸商。”
风翼理直气壮：“怎么算奸商呢？他玉佩掉池塘里了，我冒着生命危险捞上来的！”
“生命危险”
赵归涯挑眉。
“对啊！
池塘里有锦鲤！”
风翼一脸后怕地抖了抖毛，“那些鱼可凶了，上次差点把我尾巴咬秃！”
众人看着小穷奇绘声绘色的表演，都忍不住笑出声来。
楚安芷揉了揉风翼的脑袋：“好了，知道你最厉害。
不过这么多钱全押上，会不会太冒险了？”
风翼眨巴着大眼睛：“不会啊，主人从来没赌输过！”
它掰着爪子数起来，“以前在欲宗和人打赌赚了三万，在去东海交易会的时候赚了五万，在……”
赵归涯感受到自家五好青年的师尊的眼神，连忙捂住风翼的嘴巴，“行了，别说了。”
众人看着赵归涯手忙脚乱的样子，都忍俊不禁。
楚安芷双手抱胸，似笑非笑地看着自家徒弟：“看来我们小未还是个赌场老手啊？”
赵归涯干笑两声，面具下的耳尖微微发红，连忙转移话题：“那个……林清，个人第一名的奖励是什么？”
林清嗑的瓜子闻言：“哦，是拿第一的胜利去烟罗阁找魅灵典当，换取自己想要的东西。”
搞了半天就带我一只羊薅呐！
赵归涯面具下的表情凝固了，手也不捂小穷奇的嘴了，人都呆滞了。
他猛地站起身，声音都变了调，“搞了半天，如果我赢了自己薅自己的吗？！”
风翼在他肩膀上笑得打滚：“主人！
你这是要自己薅自己羊毛啊！”
林清一脸无辜地摊手：“这不是很正常吗？当时尊君知道你要参加后就改了。
再说了……”
他压低声音，“反正都是欲宗的产业，肥水不流外人田嘛。”
楚安芷忍俊不禁，轻咳一声：“小未啊，看来你这个烟罗阁主当得挺值钱。”
赵归涯气的冒烟儿：“我抗议！
这分明是压榨！
content_en:
Everyone was dumbfounded as they watched Feng Yi pour out a small mountain of spirit coins from the bracelet.
This little guy is actually richer than them all!
"Wait!"
Ouyang Xubai pressed Feng Yi's little paw, "Where did you get so much money? Could it be that you stole it from the master?"
"What, I'm not you,"
Feng Yi proudly puffed up his little chest: "This is all my own hard-earned money!"
As he spoke, he took out a small account book: "Look, every transaction is recorded!"
Zhao Guiya took the account book and flipped through it, his eyes under the mask getting wider and wider: "Good guy, you dare to make even my brother's money? What's this deal about 'helping the master's brother find the lost jade pendant for five hundred spirit coins'? You are more profiteer than me."
Feng Yi confidently said: "How can he be considered a profiteer? His jade pendant fell into the pond, and I risked my life to catch it!"
"Life-threatening"
Zhao Guiya raised his eyebrows.
"Yes!
There are koi in the pond! "
Feng Yi shook his fur with fear on his face, "Those fish are so fierce, they almost bit my tail off last time!"
Everyone couldn't help laughing when they saw Xiao Qiongqi's lifelike performance.
Chu Anzhi rubbed Fengyi's head: "Okay, I know you are the most powerful.
But is it too risky to put so much money all-in? "
Feng Yi blinked his big eyes: "No, Master has never lost a bet!"
It opened its paws and counted, "I used to make 30,000 yuan by betting with people in Yuzong, and I made 50,000 yuan when I went to the East China Sea Fair, and..."
"Stop, stop, stop!"
Zhao Guiya felt the look in his master's eyes, and quickly covered Feng Yi's mouth, "Okay, stop talking."
Everyone couldn't help but laugh when they saw Zhao Guiya's fussy appearance.
Chu Anzhi crossed her arms and looked at her apprentice with a half-smile: "It seems that our Xiaowei is still a casino veteran?"
Zhao Guiya laughed dryly, and the tips of his ears under the mask turned slightly red. He quickly changed the subject: "Um...Lin Qing, what is the reward for first place?"
Lin Qing's melon seeds heard this: "Oh, I'm going to Yanluo Pavilion to pawn the charm with the first place victory in exchange for what I want."
"Huh?"
After doing it for a long time, you brought me a sheep!
The expression under Zhao Guiya's mask was frozen, and he no longer covered Xiao Qiongqi's mouth with his hand. He was stunned.
"What?!"
He stood up suddenly, his voice changing the tone, "It took me a long time to do this, if I win, I will pick my own?!"
Fengyi rolled on his shoulder with laughter: "Master!
You are trying to pluck out your own wool! "
Lin Qing spread his hands with an innocent look on his face: "Isn't this normal? Your Majesty changed your mind when he knew you were going to participate.
Besides..."
He lowered his voice and said, "It's all the Yu Sect's property anyway, so the wealth shouldn't flow to outsiders."
Chu Anzhi couldn't help laughing and coughed lightly: "Xiao Wei, it seems that you, the master of Yanluo Pavilion, are quite valuable."
Zhao Guiya was furious: "I protest!
This is clearly oppression!
